rows.comment: as the officers are mostly sociopaths who are physically defined by their bulk

rows.dek_lead: One especially venal officer says ... adults. Ben Hania makes a meal of the police-as-dogs metaphor, as the officers are mostly sociopaths who are physically defined by their bulk, their guns, and their piggish entitlement.

rows.title: BEAUTY AND THE DOGS: Brave Storytelling
rows.comment: uncompromising vision of a real patriarchal and legally corrupt society.
rows.verdict_le10: uncompromising vision of a real patriarchal and legally corrupt society.
rows.dek_lead: Beauty and the Dogs is a sterling achievement from filmmaker Kaouther Ben Hania that features an important, uncompromising vision of a real patriarchal and legally corrupt society.
